additional_info.subject: ID0473122-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP / S7 170003921] IMD Problem CRM:03276000024
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0473122
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / S7 170003921
Charger ID / Serial No.:
x29RYt
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: IMD Problem
Based on the issue observed, it seems that the error is related to the bender unit.
IMD Bender
: Swap the unit at position -BC1 with the unit at -BC2.
Configuration:
Ensure you update the
Modbus addresses
for both units accordingly after the swap to maintain correct communication with the backend.
Observation:
If the fault
remains at the original -BC1 position
, the issue is likely in the wiring or the Bender unit itself.
If the problem persists in the original BC1, then proceed to replace the bender unit If the problem persists in the original BC1, then proceed to replace the bender unit
Insulation Monitoring Device: 8EM5903-0AA00-0AA1.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
